description: This file defines the abstract base class 'DocumentObject' for the MigraDoc Document Object Model, including methods for cloning, value management, parent/child relationships, and serialization.

classes.name: DocumentObject
classes.description: Abstract base class for all objects in the MigraDoc Document Object Model, providing cloning, parent/child management, value access, and serialization.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the DocumentObject.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates an object using the default constructor based on the specified name.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value with the specified name and flags.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets the value for the specified name and assigns parent if applicable.

methods.name: HasValue
methods.description: Checks if a value with the specified name exists.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the value with the specified name is null.

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Resets the value with the specified name to null.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the entire object is null (not set).

methods.name: SetNull
methods.description: Resets the entire object to null (not set).

methods.name: ResetCachedValues
methods.description: Resets cached properties like document and section references.
